How can we best describe the following matrix?

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}-10 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 \\ -10 & 2 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

Choose the most specific listed description: identity before diagonal, and diagonal before upper or lower triangular. Choose Other only if none of these descriptions applies.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Notice that $C$ is a matrix for which all entries above the diagonal are $0$'s:

$$
C = \begin{bmatrix}-10 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 7 & 0 \\ -10 & 2 & -2\end{bmatrix}
$$

Therefore, it is a lower triangular matrix.

It is not an upper triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element below the diagonal: ${c}_{31}=-10\ne 0.$
